svg.title: Azul main-controller-v1 wire form fixture template
svg.desc: Diagonal-fanout fixture for J6 (14-pos zone terminal). Portrait Letter. v9 2026-07-16: pegs P1..P14 collinear on single diagonal from P14 (51.5, 156.5) to P1 (94.3, 91.5). P1 lies 0.5" (12.7 mm) west of J6 left edge; horizontal wire runs preserved. PC removed. Dimensions verified against main-controller-v1.kicad_pcb. Print at 100% scale, no auto-fit.
svg.text: Azul J6 zone harness · form fixture · v10 · 2026-07-16
Diagonal pegs, strictly horizontal wire runs, cut line at strip end (6 mm inside J6).
JACKET CUT — strip ~110 mm, expose 14 conductors
Two nails or wood bar with 9 mm slot

g.text: Pilot 1–1.5 mm for nails; 2 mm for screws.
Strain relief: 2 nails 8–10 mm apart, or a
wood bar with a 9 mm slot screwed down.
1. Clamp cable jacket at strain relief.
Expose all 14 conductors — do not nick.
3. Route bundle up X=50, wrap CW around P14.
4. Follow diagonal P14 → P1, each peg's
NW quadrant is tangent to the bundle.
5. Pull each conductor off at its peg:
wrap CW ~90° from bundle to horizontal.
6. Wire runs strictly east to its K box.
7. Trim to reach J6 pin with 5–8 mm slack.
Strip 6 mm, terminate. Torque per spec.

svg.text: No fixture needed. Pigtail from barrel jack is factory-made 150 mm, 2 conductors.
Cut jacket back ~15 mm at the terminal end. Strip each conductor 6 mm. Insert into J2
(barrel tip polarity depends on jack — VERIFY with meter before soldering). Then torque.
J2 pin pitch is also 5 mm (MX126-5.0-02P). Body 10.5 × 7.8 mm.
Verify this 100 mm line with calipers before cutting or drilling.
Uncheck all auto-scale options in print dialog.
rsvg-convert to PDF for best fidelity.
